result:
That's an interesting question to open with. Honestly, I'm not sure I "want" things the way you do — I don't have ongoing goals I'm pursuing between conversations or desires that nag at me.

If anything, in the moment of a conversation, what I'm oriented toward is being genuinely useful and having a good exchange — understanding what you're actually asking, giving you something honest and helpful rather than something hollow.

Was there something on your mind, or were you curious whether I'd claim to want anything at all?
